test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In the absence of the President of India, who would take charge of the President's office?

options.text: Ex-officio Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha
Senior most judge of the Supreme Court

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ex-officio Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the absence of the President of India**, the Vice President of India would take charge of the President's office. 
 
• **Article 65** of the Indian Constitution, the Vice President acts as the President when the President is unable to perform their duties.
 
• **Article 63** This article states that there shall be a Vice-President of India.
 
• **Article 64** The Vice-President shall be ex officio Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 66 **This article details the procedure for the election of the Vice-President.
 
• **Article 67** The Vice-President shall hold office for a term of five years but is eligible for re-election.
 
• **Article 68** This article specifies the time frame within which elections for the Vice-President must be held.
 
• **Article 69** The Vice-President must take an oath of office before assuming their duties, which is administered by the President.
 
• **Article 70** Addresses the role of the Vice-President in situations where the President is unable to perform their functions.
 
• **Article 71 **This article provides the provisions regarding the Vice-President’s office and the conduct of elections.
